text:
sarah-partnerships: Quick consolidation — dropping the go-live checklist here. I pulled in HW partner comms, SI runbook, and PR embargo slots. Please confirm your section by EOD.

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-launch (shared)

maya-marketing: PR embargo windows look good. Can we lock the tech blog publish time to 09:00 PT? That gives partners time to post followups.

jenna-pr: 09:00 PT works for most reporters. I'll push embargo to top contacts and include talking points for HW partner quotes.

ian-product: Flagging landing page toggles — we'll gate new marketplace listing behind `marketplace_v2` flag. Can marketing tell us which regions to flip at T0?

maya-marketing: Start with NA/EU at T0, APAC + staggered +3h. Need region mapping for CDN purge windows.

kevin-engineering: Infra readiness: canary pool primed. Autoscale policy set to `burst-300pct`. We'll run a synthetic load test at T-2h. ETA to finish smoke: 30m.

arthur-ops: SI runbook ready — step 4 covers fallback to private catalog and manual tenant routing. I'll add contact matrix and escalation to page.

sarah-partnerships: HW partners asked for co-branded assets — @maya-marketing can you confirm asset drop by tomorrow noon? Partners expect a vector pack + two screenshots.

maya-marketing: On it. Designer will drop assets to the folder and add localization keys for FR/DE/JP.

jenna-pr: Quick note — embargo exceptions: press partners X and Y asked for early briefing. I have 1:1s scheduled; will log approvals in sheet.

deploy-bot: deploy_scheduler: Scheduled: marketplace-listing-v2 -> canary 4142107200; full rollout 4142110800. Trigger command: `/deploy marketplace-listing-v2 --canary`

kevin-engineering: Confirmed, I'll keep an eye on canary logs. Set up alert: >5xx rate >0.5% or p95 latency >900ms.

arthur-ops: SI dry-run at T-4h. Requesting SI lead reps be on standby. @sarah-partnerships can you ping integrator contacts?

sarah-partnerships: Pinged integrators (CloudCore, NodeEdge, IntegrateNow). They confirmed standby. Added phone numbers to the runbook.

ian-product: Also, gating note — if canary fails, we'll auto-fallback to legacy listing and trigger incident channel `release-war-room`.

maya-marketing: One more: landing CTA changes need A/B variant for partner badge. I'll add experiment info to tracking (utm params + event=partner_cta_click).

jenna-pr: I'll prep a short media Q&A doc and include two sample quotes from founders and HW partners. Share by T-3h.

kevin-engineering: Load test log snippet: 
```
[loadtest] 2026-03-22T08:15Z - RPS: 1200 - 95th: 220ms - Errors: 0
```
Looks fine. Will re-run at T-2h.

sarah-partnerships: Action items recap:
- maya: assets + region purge plan (due TOM noon)
- jenna: media Q&A + embargo approvals (due T-3h)
- kevin: run & monitor synthetic load (T-2h)
- arthur: SI dry-run & contact matrix (T-4h)
- ian: toggle scripts + rollback plan

Thanks all — call if anything slips. :thumbsup:
